verdict.rationale: Viam's Fleet API/CLI documentation mentions the ability to 'manage permissions and authorization' at the org/location/machine level (viam-docs-20/34/43), and machine credentials are auto-injected for hosted apps (viam-docs-52), implying some access-control primitives exist. However, there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys/tokens specifically for AI agents, nor any agent-specific credential-scoping workflow beyond generic 'permissions and authorization' management. Missing for 10: explicit API key/token scoping mechanism, agent-specific credential issuance docs, and any least-privilege role examples tied to agent use.
